page0.text:
I hear the sound of wind.
The thing running through the forest and making the trees shake creates a familiar-sounding wind.

page1.text:
...
The tremors gradually grow stronger.
...We're nearing their source.
It's probably just beyond this forest.
We're almost upon it. Just beyond this dense, overlapping wall of trees, a battle of epic proportions is happening...

page2.text:
"!"
I skid to a halt.
Right before I come into a clearing, I stop as fast as I can and hide.

page3.text:
"Berserker...!?"
Tohsaka takes cover behind a tree too, and we behold the disastrous spectacle in the clearing.

page4.text:
The clearing is literally a battlefield.
Three Servants are clashing weapons.
One is Berserker, the dark giant.
The second is the white skull-masked Assassin.
And the third...the third is...

page5.text:
"...Wait. That's...no way."
Tohsaka's voice is shaking.
...
...I can't quite hear it.
She's whispering right next to me, but the words don't enter my brain.

page6.text:
The third Servant.
It's my first time seeing the third combatant, clad in black plate armor and visor.
At the same time...
"It...can't be..."
...it immediately calls to mind someone I know well.

page7.text:
"!"
The dark giant raises a war cry.
He cleaves through the air with enough force to split a mountain, making the earth explode.

page8.text:
...
The third combatant doesn't shy away from the flying rock and gravel.
The black-armored Servant breezes past Berserker's greatsword and earthen assault, as if it's the source of this raging wind.

page9.text:
""
The roars of anguish belong to the giant.
He possesses a steel body that renders all attacks ineffective.
And the black swordsman easily slices it open.
A sword paints Berserker's flank in black, the inky light threatening to swallow him whole.

page10.text:
"No, Berserker! Run! If that gets you, you won't be able to come back to me! You don't have to fight anymore!"
Illya's voice is tearful.

page11.text:
"It's futile. Now that he's been ensnared, there is no escape."
Rather than two versus one, it seems even three opponents is too much for a great hero to overcome."
Zouken must be the one cackling.

page12.text: The two Masters, Illya and Zouken, face each other from behind the protection of their Servants.

page13.text:
In front of Zouken is Assassin, who seems to have lost to Berserker.
Berserker is in front of Illya. His entire body is being corroded by something black.

page14.text:
...A dark swamp surrounds his feet.
The ground isn't made of earth, but some bottomless pit of mud hampering his movements.
On top of that, black vines from the swamp trap his arms and legs.

page15.text:
...I know those.
They definitely belong to the Shadow.
But for an instant...
"..."
I feel like I'm looking at someone I know well.

page16.text:
"...!"
The duel reaches a new pitch, bringing me back to my senses.
...It's a desperate situation.
Berserker is strong.
He's fighting the black swordsman evenly, even as the Shadow tries to swallow him.

page17.text:
But he's at his limit.
The black swordsman easily runs forward and slashes Berserker.
Even if he's at least as strong as his opponent, Berserker's freedom of movement is stripped away as the fight drags on.
Meaning...
That the scales will only tip further in the swordsman's favor with each passing second.

page18.text:
"Hm. This outcome is clear.
Take care of the rest, Assassin. It is too risky for me to remain here any longer. Once it consumes Berserker, capture and bring back the Einzbern girl."
Zouken blends into the mist.
He's departing the forest, leaving Assassin behind.

page19.text:
"...Take heed. It consumes everything it sees.
Especially any dense sources of magical energy. Be careful not to let the Einzbern girl be taken, too."

page20.text:
His presence grows faint along with his physical form.
Zouken is gone.
Only Assassin and Berserker remain,
as well as the black swordsman, holding their weapon aloft.

page21.text:
"No. You'll die too, Berserker. Just run!"
Illya whimpers in an emotionless daze.
""
Did he hear it?
The dark giant roars and advances.

page22.text:
"Wha..."
His charge just looks like a tornado to me.
""
Berserker kicks his way out of the ground, free of the black Shadow that had swallowed him up to the waist, and charges.

page23.text:
What he's doing is inconceivable.
Not only was he being constricted by the mud at his feet. The Shadow also had him entirely bound.
He couldn't move.
His body was getting eaten by the Shadow, meaning Berserker couldn't take a single step.

page24.text:
So he decided to tear himself free.
With one hand, he grabbed the Shadow that latched to his chest and tore it off with a ripping sound.
—He literally tore his body open wherever the Shadow had grabbed him, exposing his innards.

page25.text:
His massive physique is swift.
This time, his attack is sure to crush the black swordsman.
This will likely be the last blow.
With his body ripped apart and on the verge of death, he'll make absolutely sure to kill his enemy.

page26.text:
And the swordsman answers the assault...
...with their greatest attack.
